route_title: QWOT-scaffolded 14-layer HfO2/Al2O3/SiO2 with fixed thin high-index layers
compilation_rationale: Explicit 14-layer sequence fixed with registry-resolved materials. Normal incidence UV filter optimized. Initial thicknesses set near quarter-wave values for 267 nm to align with optical design intent. Gradient optimizer constrained to 10–150 nm per layer. Three mean transmittance objectives enforce passband maximization and stopband suppression.
